claim_boundary: C2M-T0 ONLY, and this is NOT a CUDA differential. Four trivial elementwise CUDA kernels were translated through AIR and executed on the Apple GPU, matching a NUMPY CPU ORACLE -- not CUDA. No NVIDIA hardware is present, so nothing here compares against real CUDA semantics, floating-point behaviour, ordering or errors, and P2 remains open. The frontend is a PATTERN MATCHER over four expression forms, not a C expression parser: no loops, no shared memory, no atomics, no synchronization, no fp64, no multi-statement kernels, no runtime or memory API, no streams. Tiers T1 through T5 are explicitly NOT CLAIMED. Nothing was timed, so no performance claim exists.
